description.narrative: UN-Habitat, a specialized agency of the United Nations, is mandated to enhance the social and physical sustainability of cities and towns worldwide. As a pivotal entity within the UN system for urbanization issues, UN-Habitat fosters community reconstruction efforts in crisis-affected countries, empowering residents both socially and economically while restoring property rights for a stable society. In the Arab region, UN-Habitat has extensive experience in urban rehabilitation post-conflict or natural disasters. Notably, in Iraq, UN-Habitat swiftly initiated community housing rehabilitation upon areas being declared safe, facilitating dignified return for displaced populations. Since 2015, over 2,400 severely damaged homes have been rehabilitated in conflict zones such as West Mosul, Nineveh Plain, Sinjar, Ramadi, and Fallujah, prioritizing homes in dire need based on technical assessments. In Mosul, 110 homes were restored in 2020 with funding from the Kuwait Relief Society. Key to UN-Habitat's approach is the employment of returnees and local community members in rehabilitation efforts, thereby creating employment opportunities and supporting livelihoods. Engineers oversee all project activities on-site to ensure quality and manage final audits through advanced monitoring and evaluation methods, including the Habitat electronic platform. In addition to its efforts in Iraq, in this project UN-Habitat will actively be involved in rehabilitating damaged housing units in Derna, Libya. Following the destruction caused by conflicts and natural phenomena, UN-Habitat has been instrumental in restoring housing units to provide safe and sustainable living conditions for residents. Through technical assessments and community engagement, UN-Habitat prioritizes the rehabilitation of homes most severely affected, aiming to rebuild communities and support the recovery process in Derna. UN-Habitat's commitment to sustainable urban development is evident in its comprehensive approach to housing rehabilitation, fostering resilience and promoting sustainable recovery in crisis-affected communities.
